premise: Badger digs out his scratchy old bed and fetches fresh grass for his burrow, and by the time it is soft, Hedgehog has curled up in it first.
inspiration: Goldilocks (folk), turned: the one who finds the bed taken makes room, and the guest is welcome.
lesson: Sharing what you made makes it better.
learning: Badgers carry fresh grass into their burrows for a soft bed

en-US.title: Badger Makes a Bed
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 50s} As the sun went down, {badger:enter} Badger came trotting home. {badger:face sad} His bed was old and scratchy. {badger:live} He sniffed, dug out the old grass with his paws, pushed his nose in… and popped up with earth on his nose, grinning. Time for fresh grass! {mouse:enter} {mouse:hop} Mouse scampered over to help. {sfx:rustle} Rustle, rustle, they carried soft, dry grass into the burrow, {badger:face happy} until the bed was deep and soft. While they fetched one more bundle, {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying by. He climbed in, {hedgehog:live hold} tucked in his nose and curled into a spiny ball. {badger:face surprised} [gasps] Who's that? said Badger. {mouse:live} Mouse sniffed. He stood on tiptoe to look… then dropped down and washed his face. [giggles] It's Hedgehog! {hedgehog:live resume} Slowly, the ball uncurled, peeked out and sniffed. [curious] Is this bed for anyone? asked Hedgehog. {badger:wobble} [softly] There's room for three, said Badger. And they all {badger:face sleeping} {mouse:face sleeping} {hedgehog:face sleeping} slept in the softest bed in the forest.

es-ES.title: Tejón hace la cama
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 50s} Cuando el sol se ponía, {badger:enter} Tejón llegó trotando a casa. {badger:face sad} Su cama estaba vieja y picaba. {badger:live} Olfateó, sacó la hierba vieja con las patas, metió el hocico… y asomó con tierra en la nariz, sonriendo. ¡Hace falta hierba fresca! {mouse:enter} {mouse:hop} Ratón vino correteando a ayudar. {sfx:rustle} Fru, fru, llevaron hierba suave y seca a la madriguera, {badger:face happy} hasta que la cama quedó honda y blandita. Mientras traían el último montón, {hedgehog:enter} Erizo pasó por allí correteando. Se metió dentro, {hedgehog:live hold} escondió la nariz y se hizo una bola de pinchos. {badger:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Quién es ese?, dijo Tejón. {mouse:live} Ratón olfateó. Se puso de puntillas para mirar… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. [giggles] ¡Es Erizo! {hedgehog:live resume} Poco a poco, la bola se desenrolló, asomó y olfateó. [curious] ¿Esta cama es para alguien?, preguntó Erizo. {badger:wobble} [softly] Aquí cabemos tres, dijo Tejón. Y todos {badger:face sleeping} {mouse:face sleeping} {hedgehog:face sleeping} durmieron en la cama más blandita del bosque.
